title: Chapter 6461: Earthsplitter Ancestor

Chapter 6461: Earthsplitter Ancestor

Chapter 6461: Earthsplitter Ancestor

“Buzz.” The light intensified and added a glowing layer to everything.

“The source of Gold Village.” Spectators became emotional; their doubts dissipated.

The mines couldn’t exude such a powerful glow, perhaps only the source could. The light also rippled like water like a golden spring flowing in the air.

It was dense enough to be almost like water. Those washed in it felt their golden power increasing. They no longer needed to channel their power and still glowed brightly.

Those within Octagon resonated the most due to the close distance. The golden trees of cultivators grew at a rapid rate.

Golden laws erupted and turned Octagon into an ocean.

“So this is the spring.” Black Wind and the others became emotional.

The result would be unimaginable if they could root their trees into this spring. They would go beyond being the lord but more like the founder god of Gold Village.

“Boom!” In another corner of Golden Village, a golden tree emerged, accompanied by many visual phenomena of great Buddhas. Each started chanting and their mantras turned into golden laws.

“Timeless Buddha...” A supreme Buddha appeared and shattered all falseness in the world. He entered Octagon and made everyone have the urge to convert to Buddhism.

“Rising Buddha!” Weaker living beings prostrated, unable to resist.

Virtuoso and Goldblade Emperor frowned slightly upon seeing him.

He was an earth ancestor from Immortal Gate who became stronger after arriving in Gold Village. The improvement made him catch up to a heaven ancestor such as Ocena-gaze.

This had to do with his background - the most orthodox Buddhist sect - Lankavatara Temple.

He was an enlightened monk who joined Xian Chengtian who helped him break the limit.

“The golden spring!” His golden power took over Octagon - an attempt to monopolize the spring.

Virtuoso and Goldblade felt their spines bending, unable to withstand the pressure.

“The spring isn’t for you to monopolize, Rising.” Someone uttered coldly.

Cracks appeared on the Buddhist domain immediately. In another direction of Gold Village, another towering tree appeared. This one’s golden power was sharp and violent, capable of mincing anything into pieces.

A woman walked out gracefully with crimson eyes and red lips. She exuded unmatched beauty - the embodiment of a vermillion rose.

However, her aura was that of a raging dragon preparing to rend heaven and earth. It made others tremble in fear, desolate gods and emperors included.

It manifested into tornados. Unfortunately for some victims, they were helpless and caught, screaming before death.

“Earthsplitter Ancstor!” She had a more notorious reputation than Rising Buddha and Ocean-gaze Ancestor.

Her husband was Skyriser Ancestor - the co-founder of the sect along with Seventy-two Origin Ancestor.

He came from a great clan and was an influential cultivator while his co-founder was only a nobody.

However, he offered his full support and nearly spent all of his riches so that Seventy-two Origin Ancestor could succeed.

Seventy-two Origin Ancestor never forgot this favor and taught him everything in return. The latter didn’t let him down and became an eternal ancestor. His wife also benefited from this and became a heaven ancestor.
